projects.title: EduTrace
projects.summary: Decentralized academic record ledger using Soulbound Tokens (ERC-5192) and predictive time-series performance analysis.
projects.problem: Academic credential verification challenges and lack of early warning indicators for student retention.
projects.solution: Immutable credential minting on an EVM ledger paired with an analytics dashboard and Go event indexing pipeline.

projects.title: GDGOC E-Commerce
projects.summary: E-commerce backend service built in Go demonstrating strict 4-layer Clean Architecture with Swagger documentation.
projects.problem: Monolithic API architectures often lack clear separation of concerns, complicating long-term maintenance and testing.
projects.solution: Decoupled architecture separating Domain entities, UseCases, Repositories, and HTTP Handlers using net/http and MongoDB.

projects.title: Maritime AI Dashboard
projects.summary: Maritime vessel telemetry and route analytics dashboard integrating FastAPI Python services with Next.js.
projects.problem: Consolidating and visualizing disparate maritime vessel telemetry streams in an interactive web interface.
projects.solution: FastAPI data service coupled with a responsive Next.js and TypeScript frontend for telemetry and analytics review.

projects.title: Smart Kitchen
projects.summary: Kitchen management and recipe recommendation backend built with Go Fiber, PostgreSQL, and Google Generative AI.
projects.problem: Automated inventory routines and contextual recipe planning in connected kitchen environments.
projects.solution: Go Fiber REST API integrating PostgreSQL via GORM, scheduled cron tasks, and Generative AI services.
